newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI approves cover of any Seat unit wind-up costs.
newsitem.headline: IRI approves cover of any Seat unit wind-up costs.

text.p: Italian state industrial holding IRI approved a plan to cover any additional costs deriving from the liquidation of a unit of telephone directory publisher Seat, IRI board members said.
The unit in question, MMP, is entirely controlled by Seat and has been put into liquidation.

Seat itself is due to be privatised and the plan, approved in a meeting with IRI sole shareholder the Italian Treasury, means the eventual purchaser of Seat will not have to cover any eventual costs of MMP's liquidation.
MMP lost around 180 billion lire in 1996 and reports say it is likely to lose a further 55 billion this year.
